tabs.overview: Cluster efficiency, stage isolation, and frac hits show up in the data during and after the job; permanent installs also watch production.
tabs.engineering: Interrogator at surface; cable protected across the couplings; orientation to avoid perforating it.
tabs.evidence: Field practice at the frac van and wellsite instrumentation (S9); pressure transducer practice (S31 missile patent for header instruments); no vendor data.

name: Fiber optic sensing (DAS and DTS)
function: A fiber optic cable, cemented behind casing or run on wireline or coiled tubing, interrogated for acoustic energy and temperature along its length to show which clusters take fluid and where fractures cross.
